Hi Javier,

Please find attached the deliverables we promised: demarcation-diagram-v2.pdf (annotated), evidence-index-ACME.csv (artifact mapping), and sig-answers-acme.docx (draft responses). Key highlights up front:

- Data plane vs control plane: Customer inference inputs and artifact KV caches reside on tenant-specific storage within the selected deployment (Dedicated: Redwood-managed tenant VLANs; Private: customer-managed VPC or on-prem enclave). Control-plane APIs (model management, billing telemetry) are reachable only over authenticated egress or private links and are segregated by tenant authentication tokens.
- KMS boundary: Customer keys are used for model encryption at rest; KMS interactions are logged and tied to SOC2 key-management controls. For Private on-prem installs, keys can remain in-customer HSM; we document both flows in the CSV.
- Evidence mapping: the CSV lists which diagram figure or snippet maps to each SIG/CAIQ question. Where we reference SOC2, we point to section numbers in soc2-reference-appendix.pdf (redacted copy available on request).
